d:
Hey everyone! My transformation comic, "Role-Swap!", is here!

I'm releasing it for free over here and on my Deviantart with a few pages per week.

Role-Swap! comes in at around 40 pages and contains double TG, slight AP/AR, and bimbofication. It's been available on my Patreon for a while, and you can get access to its PDF version as well as my currently serializing comic over on that website.
And even if you can't contribute and plan to read them over here whenever they get realeased for free, I'm still very grateful for the support!

So, if you would like to contribute, here's my Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/c/DoloTFs
